english:
An ally gaining Flux of Darkness or Field of Light grants you 6%|12%|18%|24%|30% increased Weapon Damage against Cabal combatants for 20 seconds.

The buff is lost upon gaining either Flux of Darkness or Field of Light.

source.text:
When an ally gains Flux of Darkess or Field of Light:

6% | 12% | 18% | 24% | 30% increased Weapon Damage towards Cabal Combatants for 20 seconds.

Buff is lost upon acquiring either Flux of Darkness or Field of Light.
